violations.affected_code: GestureDetector(onTap: onPressed, child: Container(... child: Text('Continue', ...)))
violations.explanation: The custom button is built with GestureDetector and Container, so it exposes no button role to assistive technologies. Screen readers announce only the text 'Continue' and do not indicate that it is actionable. Wrap it in Semantics(button: true, ...) or use a Material button such as ElevatedButton or FilledButton.

violations.type: Custom interactive control lacks keyboard/focus support
violations.explanation: GestureDetector is not focusable and does not respond to keyboard or switch activation (Enter/Space). Users of keyboards, switch access or other non-pointer input cannot reach or activate the control. Use InkWell or a Material button, or add FocusableActionDetector or Focus with activation shortcuts.
The control exposes no enabled/disabled state to accessibility services. Standard buttons provide this state automatically.
